assumptions: psnrhvs -> psnrhvs::psnrhvs_rgb8 (lib.rs:369-459): each RGB channel deinterleaved to f32 0-255 plane, scored by plane_step_impl step=8 (kernel.rs:592+ / band_body kernel.rs:259-415), VPQM-06/07 masked DCT energy; combined = mean of 3 planes. Blocks nb_x=1+(w-8)/8 x nb_y=1+(h-8)/8.

Per block-pair totals: mul 2315, add+sub 2727, fma 510, div 87, sqrt 2, abs 64, cmp 65, load 128 -> /64 per covered elem.
finalize (lib.rs:248-): masked/unmasked mse -> two log10 scores per plane.
